purpose: Contextual candidate map for English material and Tamil grammatical boundaries under a declared mixed-script annotation policy.

apply_policy.default: Inspect the source context before applying any candidate, including high_confidence entries.
apply_policy.review_required: Category names indicate review priority, not calibrated probabilities; uncertain language identity or morphology stays pending.
apply_policy.never_translate: For transcription, do not translate or invent language switches. For rewriting, follow the declared source-faithfulness and orthography policy.
apply_policy.record_metadata: Record each actual replacement, its source context and unresolved candidates; preserve original text.
